<?php
echo "run";
class A { const X="x"; }
class B { const int X=A::X; }
echo B::X;

<?php
echo "run";
class B { const int X=A::X; }
class A { const X="x"; }
echo B::X;

<?php
class A { protected const X=self::Y; private const Y=11; public static function v(){return static::X;} }
class B extends A { const Y=22; }
echo B::v();

<?php
echo "before";
class A { private const X=MISSING; }
echo A::X;

<?php
function c(){echo "C";return "Missing";}
function n(){echo "N";return "X";}
try { echo Missing::{n()}; } catch(Error $e) { echo "L"; }
try { echo c()::{n()}; } catch(Error $e) { echo "D"; }

<?php
class A { const float F=1; const X=[1]; }
echo A::F===1.0 ? "f" : "i";
$v=A::X; $v[0]=3; echo A::X[0],$v[0];

<?php
class A { const X=MISSING; }
try { echo A::X; } catch(Error $e) { echo "caught"; }
const MISSING=12;
echo A::X;

<?php
echo "before";
class A { const X=MISSING; function __construct(){echo "CTOR";} }
new A;

<?php
echo Missing::{42};

<?php
class C {
 const X=Missing::{42};
}
echo C::X;

<?php

 const X=self::{N};
}
const N="CLASS";
echo C::X;

<?php

 const X=1/MISSING;
}
echo A::X;

<?php

 const X=self::Y;
 const Y=self::X;
}
echo A::X;

<?php
class A {private const X=1;}
class B extends A {}
echo B::X;

<?php
class A{const X=N;}
const N=12;
const G=A::X;
echo G;

<?php
class A{const X=N;}
function f($x=A::X){echo $x;}
const N=12;
f(); f();

<?php
class A{const X=[N];}
const N=1;
$v=A::X; $v[0]=3; echo A::X[0],$v[0];

<?php
echo "run";
const X=Missing::{42};

<?php
echo "run";
function f($x=Missing::{42}) {echo "body";}
f();

<?php
echo "run";
class C {}
const N="CLASS";
const X=C::{N};

<?php
echo "run";
class C {}
const N="CLASS";
function f($x=C::{N}) {echo "body";}
f();
<?php class A{const X=1/MISSING;} echo A::X;

<?php
echo "run";
class A {
 const int X=MISSING . "";
}
const MISSING="x";
echo A::X;

<?php
echo "run";
include __DIR__ . "/cross_file_simple_child.php";
echo A::X;

<?php
echo "run";
include __DIR__ . "/cross_file_typed_child.php";
const MISSING="x";
echo A::X;

<?php
echo "run";
class A {final public const int X=1;}
class B extends A {private const string X="x";}

<?php
echo "run";
class A {private const X=MISSING;}
class B extends A {public const Y=N;}
const N=1;
echo B::Y;
new B;
echo "after";

<?php
echo "run";
class A {private const X=MISSING; public const Y=N;}
const N=1;
echo A::Y;
if (true) {class B extends A {}}
new B;
echo "after";

<?php
echo "run";
class A {private const X=MISSING;}
class B extends A {public const X=1;}
echo B::X;
new B;
echo "after";

<?php
echo "run";
class A {public const int X=1;}
class B extends A {protected const string X="x";}

<?php
echo "run";
class A {const int|string X=1;}
class B extends A {const int X=2;}
echo B::X;

<?php
echo "run";
class A {const int X=1;}
class B extends A {const X=2;}

<?php
echo "run";
interface I {const X=1;}
interface J {const X=1;}
class C implements I,J {}

<?php
echo "run";
interface I {const X=1;}
interface L extends I {}
interface R extends I {}
class C implements L,R {}
echo C::X;

<?php
echo "run";
interface I {const X=1;}
interface J {const X=1;}
class C implements I,J {const X=2;}
echo C::X;

<?php
echo "run";
class A {private const int X=1;}
class B extends A {public const string X="x";}
echo B::X;

<?php
echo "run";
class A {final const X=1; public function f(){}}
class B extends A {const X=2; protected function f(){}}

<?php
echo "run";
class A {public const X="x";}
include __DIR__."/folded-child.php";
echo "after";
